title: Llama 4
before: Llama models were dense and text-first.
problem: Dense models had become uncompetitive on cost against the open MoE models coming out of China.
breakthrough: Meta's first mixture-of-experts models, natively multimodal, with very long advertised context.
why: It brought Meta into the MoE era, and turned out to be the last open Llama generation.
next: Meta pivoted to the closed Muse Spark line in April 2026.
inherits: MoE as the default frontier architecture, open or closed.
